notes:
Statistics retained as printed. Original and replication tests extracted independently. No metric conversion. Original outcome is recall of individual items; replication describes its results tables as correctly recalled lists while methods concern word order. Corresponding main effect matched by experiment and factor; this outcome-label discrepancy is retained.
Completion source review (n_r): Procedure explicitly divides participants into two groups of 14, each completing both task conditions used in the main-effect analysis.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Named Experiment 3 main effect; preserve printed partial eta-squared without metric conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Exact p printed for the same main-effect F test and partial eta-squared.
